messages:
hazel: Hey team — prepping a TF change to update app-statefulset from 3 -> 5 replicas and add a partitioned rollingUpdate for a staged canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/925. Quick Qs: does anyone see PDB/HPA/secret fallout?

ron: cc @anand @sophie. Main HPA is rps-based; minReplicas is currently 2 so bumping replicas should be fine but verify targetUtilization. PDB has maxUnavailable: 1 — with 5 replicas that holds. Suggest bumping readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds to 30s for the slower pods after the model shard change.

anand: looking now. Noticed TF also changes k8s_secret.data['service_key'] path -> 'prod/service/key_v2'. If we rollout without rotation, pods may fail to read the new key. Need a secret rotation step in the CD job or use a projected secretVersion approach. Also +1 on partitioned rollout: set partition=3 for the first canary wave.

sophie: What's the canary window? We usually do ~10% for 30m. With 5 replicas 10% is ~1 pod — maybe iterate 1 -> 2 -> 5 with 15-20m waits. Also double-check resourceRequests: the new model shard increases mem usage on startup.

k8s-bot: k8s-lint: PR #925 — readinessProbe missing timeoutSeconds (default 1s); flagged. Also checked: service account roles OK.

ron: Proposed rollout patch snippet to include in the PR:
```yaml
rollingUpdate:
  partition: 3
  maxUnavailable: 1
```
And readiness tweak in statefulset spec:
```yaml
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /health
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 30
  timeoutSeconds: 5
```
Also propose reducing cpu request for canary pods from 500m -> 400m to avoid immediate bin-packing.

hazel: Thanks. I'll update the PR with partition=3, readiness timeout, and link to the secret rotation playbook. @anand can you add the secret rotation step to the CD job and run a TF plan? Please paste the plan summary here when ready.

anand: On it — running `terraform plan -out=plan.tfout` now. Will post the plan summary in ~15m. I'll add a CI migration step: apply secret v2 as a separate kubectl/helm job, then toggle the path in TF after verification.

hazel: Cool. Will merge after plan + green CI. Holding canary for 30m and watching latency/cold-starts. Thanks :thumbsup:
